q1.answer_given: Kwan raised a single parent of four taxed on spousal/child support income but ineligible for CERB, unresolved three weeks after the Employment Minister said she was looking into it; Trudeau acknowledged gaps from moving quickly but gave no fix timeline. Kwan called federal shelter funding 'deficient' and flagged that Vancouver East's large urban-indigenous population got under 2% of pandemic indigenous housing funds; Trudeau pointed to hundreds of millions already sent to shelters and defended the 50%-homelessness-reduction housing strategy as ambitious. On seniors, Kusie called the up-to-$500 OAS/GIS payment an 'afterthought' delivered three months in; Schulte cited a $20M New Horizons for Seniors expansion for services like grocery delivery, and May flagged an unaddressed funding gap for non-profit seniors homes with rising costs. Separately, Tochor asked how CERB's $2,000 compared with seniors' $1,200 and disability's $1,600 payments; Qualtrough said ESDC/Finance set it based on typical lost employment income, and Hussen cited $350 million in charity-sector funding.
